hardware: 1x Blackhole p300c chip (mesh 1x1), via gozer lease

fit.note: s_per_step_naive falls 1.287 -> 0.749 across the sweep only because it divides the fixed cost by the step count; the marginal cost is flat.

frames_scaling.note: linear in frames at fixed steps

cold_start.note: per-process, not per-shape: the first 8- and 16-step calls matched their warm medians at 1.02x and 0.99x.

limitations: One chip, one model, one host. Nothing here is a multi-chip number: the model is single-device (see tt_model_package.yaml).
n=3 warm repeats per point; median and full range are reported, never a bare mean.
Latency is end-to-end HTTP including base64 encoding of a ~2 MB GIF, not device time.
The step sweep fit is over three points. It is tight (residuals <= 0.04s) but three points cannot distinguish linear from very-nearly-linear.
